thought.text: System packages are in. Now let me start PostgreSQL (no systemd in container) and download Ruby/Node tarballs.

reasoning_content:
System packages installation complete. Next, check whether postgres is running (this container may not have systemd). Start postgres, and in parallel download the Ruby 3.1.4 and Node 20.11.0 tarballs.

Actually, first let's check the status of the postgres service and start it manually.

action.command: service postgresql start 2>&1 || pg_ctlcluster 14 main start 2>&1; sleep 2; su postgres -c "psql -c 'select version();'" 2>&1 | head -3

tool_call.name: terminal
